requirements.requirement: The system must define a MongoDB collection named PublicHealthData.prescriptions with a formally declared schema object.
The system must include a required NPI field in the schema and enforce it as a non-null string matching 10-digit format.
The system must include drug identifier fields (at minimum drug_name or NDC) and enforce at least one identifier is present per document.
The system must include numeric claim count fields and enforce they are integers greater than or equal to zero.
The system must include a condition_taxonomy field derived from drug mapping and enforce it as a non-empty array of strings.
The system must define validation rules compatible with ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py and successfully register the schema through those utilities.
The system must reject any document missing required fields (NPI, drug identifier, claim counts) during validation.
The system must reject any document where claim count fields contain non-numeric or negative values.
The system must accept a valid sample prescription document that conforms to the schema without validation errors.
The system must produce a schema definition file consistent in structure with Code/Schemas/ChatHealthy.Providers.json.
The system must define an ingestion contract specifying required fields, optional fields, and field data types for incoming pipeline data.
The system must ensure the schema supports idempotent writes by allowing a deterministic compound key (e.g., NPI + drug identifier + reporting period).
